outcome: neonatal outcomes (birth weight, Apgar scores, neonatal complications, NICU admission, SARS-CoV-2 positivity)
cohort: 230 pregnant women admitted for delivery at an urban tertiary care center in India between August 1, 2020, and October 30, 2020, with 73 testing positive for SARS-CoV-2.
finding: There was no significant difference in the incidence of preterm birth between SARS-CoV-2-positive and SARS-CoV-2-negative pregnant women.
